## Acronyms and Abbreviations {.unnumbered}

| Acronym    | Description                                             |
|:-----------|:--------------------------------------------------------|
| ABS        | Australian Bureau of Statistics                         |  
| AEDC       | Australian Early Development Census                     | 
| AIHW       | Australian Institute of Health and Welfare              | 
| AIR        | Australian Immunisation Register                        | 
| ACPCC      | Australian Centre for the Prevention of Cervical Cancer | 
| BSWPHU     | Barwon South West Public Health Unit                    | 
| COPD       | Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease                   | 
| CtG        | Closing the Gap                                         | 
| ERP        | Estimated Residential Population                        | 
| GPHU       | Grampians Public Health Unit                            | 
| GRPHU      | Gippsland Public Health Unit                            | 
| GVPHU      | Goulburn Valley Public Health Unit                      | 
| IARE       | Indigenous Area of Residence                            | 
| LMPHU      | Loddon Mallee Public Health Unit                        | 
| LGA        | Local Government Area                                   | 
| NAPLAN     | National Assessment Program – Literacy and Numeracy     | 
| NEPHU      | North Eastern Public Health Unit                        | 
| NIP        | National Immunisation Program                           | 
| OMPHU      | Ovens Murray Public Health Unit                         | 
| PHESS      | Public Health Event Surveillance System                 | 
| PHIDU      | Public Health Information Development Unit              | 
| SA2        | Statistical Area Level 2                                | 
| SEPHU      | South Eastern Public Health Unit                        | 
| VCAMS      | Victorian Child and Adolescent Monitoring System        |
| WPHU       | Western Public Health Unit                              |
